verdict_text:
YES

The mapping `{old: new for new, old in enumerate(kept)}` yields exactly the renumbering the spec lists (0→0, 1→1, 3→2, … 15→11), keys are rebuilt into a fresh dict so no collision can occur, non-block tensors are copied through untouched, and both required checks (contiguous 0..11 block set, which also excludes any block ≥12; total of 86 tensors) run before `save_file`, so a failure exits non-zero with no output written. One thing I could not verify from reading alone: the imported helper `_ckpt.load_checkpoint` is not part of the artifact shown, so correctness depends on it loading all 114 tensors from both shards via `model.safetensors.index.json`.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
